Class SlotGroup

java.lang.Object
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.SlotGroup
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.SlotGroupLike
public class SlotGroup extends Object implements com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.SlotGroupLike
Where structure lives. A SlotGroup is the composition of Storage, shift-click priority, capabilities (right-click), and layout metadata.

The group owns its slots' structure — storage, layout, pairing, priority. It no longer owns the behavioral contract (accept/remove/stack-cap, quick-move, binding, mending): under THE ONE WINDOW those all resolve from the WindowEngine keyed by each slot's MKCSlot.address(), so a group declares structure once and behavior is armed by Address (default = pure vanilla). This keeps slots thin (identity only) and the group structure-only.

Implements SlotGroupLike so consumer code can program against a uniform interface shared with VirtualSlotGroup (observed screens).

Part of the canonical MenuKit hierarchy: Screen → Panel → SlotGroup → MKCSlot

      public SlotGroup(String id, com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.Storage storage, int shiftClickPriority, int columns, int rowGapAfter, int rowGapSize)
      Full constructor with layout metadata.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier within the panel
      storage - where items live
      shiftClickPriority - numeric priority (higher = tried first)
      columns - grid columns for slot layout (-1 = auto)
      rowGapAfter - 0-indexed row after which to insert a gap (-1 = none)
      rowGapSize - gap size in pixels (only used if rowGapAfter >= 0)

    • getSlots

      @Internal public List<MKCSlot> getSlots(net.minecraft.world.inventory.AbstractContainerMenu handler)
      Returns this group's slots as a list, extracted from the handler's flat slot list. Convenience for consumers that need to iterate a group's slots without walking the flat index range manually.

      Returns List<MKCSlot> — a valid covariant override of SlotGroupLike.getSlots(AbstractContainerMenu)'s List<? extends Slot>.

      Internal plumbing (see SlotGroupLike.getSlots(AbstractContainerMenu)) — returns live slots for the grouping engine, no consumer caller.

      Specified by:
      getSlots in interface com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.SlotGroupLike
      Parameters:
      handler - the handler whose slot list contains this group's slots
      Returns:
      unmodifiable list of MKCSlots in this group

    • pairsWith

      public SlotGroup pairsWith(SlotGroup target)
      Declares that shift-click from this group should prefer the target group over numeric priority. This is how furnace-style affinities work: fuel items target the fuel slot, smeltable items target the input slot.
